subject: Web Development
title: JavaScript's Unwritten Future
description: A micro-lesson that makes JavaScript's Unwritten Future usable.

hook.text: After thirty years, JavaScript is still evolving with annual ECMAScript updates.

buildup.text: Proposals like pattern matching, decorators, and records are working through the standards.

discovery.text: WebAssembly challenges JavaScript's monopoly but also extends what web apps can do.

twist.text: AI coding assistants may write more JavaScript than humans within a few years.

climax.text: The language born from a ten-day sprint shows no signs of slowing after three decades.

punchline.text: JavaScript outlived every prediction of its death.

quiz.question: What is WebAssembly's relationship to JavaScript?
